# FIXTURE: bad-01 — short frame (1 word + לֵאמֹר) isolated on its own line
# Violation: short frame (1 prosodic word) isolated; speech content on next line
# Rule: H5/speech-framing, STRONG-MERGE-CANDIDATE
# Expected: ≥1 finding with severity STRONG-MERGE-CANDIDATE

1:1
וַיֹּאמֶר לֵאמֹר
קוּם לֵךְ אֶל נִינְוֵה הָעִיר הַגְּדוֹלָה׃
